headline: Advance Agrolife Limited: Monitoring Agency Report for Q1 FY2026-27
sum: Advance Agrolife files Q1 FY2026-27 Monitoring Agency Report with NSE, disclosing utilization of IPO proceeds for the quarter ended 30 June 2026. The report forms part of the company's post-IPO compliance obligations under stock exchange listing rules.
detail: Advance Agrolife Limited, an agrochemical and seed company, filed its quarterly Monitoring Agency Report with the National Stock Exchange (NSE) on 6 August 2026, covering the quarter ended 30 June 2026. The report is filed by an independent Monitoring Agency (typically a merchant banker or audit firm appointed pre-IPO) to verify that IPO proceeds are being utilized in accordance with the objects stated in the prospectus. This is a standard post-IPO compliance requirement under SEBI (Issue of Capital and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2018, and stock exchange listing rules, and must be filed quarterly for up to one year post-listing (extendable). The specific utilization amounts and allocation across objects are contained in the PDF filing.
